verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware product with no web API of its own, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this product type. The probe confirms no OpenAPI spec exists at the candidate developer.nvidia.com paths. Adjacent NVIDIA services such as build.nvidia.com inference endpoints and NIM are separate products and do not make this axis apply to the GPU.
